title: Renewal that alters the whole layout but adds one wheelchair space
why: Table 5 needs 2 at 100 m; Appendix F waives spaces only if the doorways cannot be modified, which the spec cannot show.

spec.name: Renewal that alters the whole layout but adds one wheelchair space

wheelchair_spaces.required: ≥ 2, unless the doorways cannot be modified
wheelchair_spaces.rationale: Table 5: 1 < 2 at 100 m. Appendix F: 'if the entrance doorway, or clearways, cannot be modified to enable wheelchair access, a wheelchair space does not need to be provided'. A person must judge the doorways.
